summary_en: MP-2611 Co., Ltd. announced plans to launch a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Wacom Co., Ltd. (excluding treasury stock and non-tendering agreements) and all ADRs, with the offer expected to commence in mid-February 2027 pending regulatory clearance from competition and investment control authorities in Japan, Taiwan, Australia, Germany, and Bulgaria.
title_en: Announcement of Plans to Commence a Tender Offer for Shares of Wacom Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 6727) by MP-2611 Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief:
MP-2611 Co., Ltd. announced on November 20, 2026, its decision to acquire all ordinary shares of Wacom Co., Ltd. (listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market, ticker 6727) through a tender offer, excluding treasury stock held by Wacom and shares subject to non-tendering agreements. The acquirer also plans to acquire all American Depositary Receipts issued by Wacom. The acquisition is contingent upon obtaining regulatory clearances from competition authorities and investment control regulators in Japan, Taiwan, Australia, Germany, and Bulgaria. SESP (Samsung Electronics Singapore Pte. Ltd.), which holds 8,398,400 shares (6.32% ownership), is a party to a transaction agreement with MBKP Fund related to the offer structure.

MP-2611 and Wacom have already executed the tender offer agreement as of November 20, 2026. The bidder expects to commence the tender offer in mid-February 2027, based on current estimates of the time required for regulatory filings and clearance processes. However, the precise timing of clearance from foreign regulatory authorities cannot be accurately predicted, and MP-2611 committed to announcing detailed scheduling promptly once determined. The bidder has engaged with international law firms to prepare filings with domestic and foreign authorities and intends to submit notifications for competition law review and investment control approval as soon as preparations are complete. Among the eight enumerated conditions precedent, the bidder may waive conditions (①, ②, ⑤, ⑧) but cannot waive conditions (③, ④, ⑥, ⑦). Condition ④ regarding regulatory clearance from SESP-related authorities cannot be waived without SESP consent, unless the waiting period is reasonably expected to expire by the end of the tender offer period.
